title: The solution of a linear equation
caption: x = 14/5 = 2.8 is where (2x + 1)/3 − (x − 2)/4 reaches 2: substituting it gives 11.6/3 − 0.8/4 = 2.
alt: A number line from 0 to 5 with the point 14/5 = 2.8 marked.
description: The number line runs from 0 to 5.
The solution x = 14/5 = 2.8 sits between 2 and 3.
Substituting 14/5 into the left side gives exactly 2, the right side.

checks.name: at x = 14/5 the left side (2x + 1)/3 − (x − 2)/4 equals 2
